name: getApplicationStructure
description: This tool generates the employee benefit application structure. Before generating the structure, it first executes the "getBenefitApplicationTypesDetails" tool to retrieve all available benefit application types. These type names are displayed to the user, and upon selection, the corresponding name is used as the benCode argument for the next step.
